General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the ALL METAL Chrome Lock Relocation Kit
HEAVY DUTY (Won™t Strip Off)
Used in conjunction with the newer style Door Handles to move the Door Lock from above the Handle to the top of the Door.
So if you need a new OEM lock mechanism, handle or bezel on your 1986-1993 Samurai, now you can still keep the interior door lock/unlock lever by simply installing this kit.
The kit contains everything you need and it is simple to install.
Also repairs lock problems on the 1994 and 1995 Samurais.
No modifications needed.
Does BOTH door locks!
COLOR: Chrome
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Door Lock Knob (Chrome)
Qty 2 – Grommet (Black)
Qty 1 – Rod, LH Lock
Qty 1 – Rod, RH Lock
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
